name: hx_ees_function
title: Heat exchangers: the EES HX function (effectiveness-NTU by flow arrangement)
summary: The HX function of the EES heat exchanger library as a library function: epsilon = HX(TypeHX$, NTU, C_dot_1, C_dot_2, 'epsilon') and its inverse 'NTU' for parallel flow, counterflow, the three crossflow arrangements, N shell passes, the nine TEMA E/G/H/J types and the balanced regenerator. A model written for EES runs unchanged with $INCLUDE hx_ees_function.

authors: S. Klein and G. Nellis (EES heat exchanger library, F-Chart Software): the HX function and its interface
T. L. Bergman, A. S. Lavine, F. P. Incropera and D. P. DeWitt (both fluids mixed, N shell passes)
R. K. Shah and D. P. Sekulic; W. Rohsenow, J. Hartnett and Y. Cho (TEMA relations, through CSL-0102)
W. M. Kays and A. L. London (regenerator)
Caleb Bell (ht library, the relations of CSL-0090 and CSL-0102)
origin.notes: Written for the CoolSolve Library from the documentation of the EES HX function (its interface, flow types and worked examples; the EES source is not distributed) and from the published relations; the relations of CSL-0090 and CSL-0102 are included, not copied. Replaces the CoolSolve gap CS-GAP-HX: the function is ordinary library code instead of a CoolSolve built-in.

verification.summary: Compared with the 33 worked examples of the EES help (one page per type, UA = 75 W/K, C_dot_1 = 50 W/K, C_dot_2 = 30 W/K, epsilon = 0.61): 32 agree to every printed digit (max relative deviation 3.5e-4, rounding of the 3-4 printed digits); the regenerator gives 0.8560 against 0.8559 (Kays and London relation, EES uses Dragutinovic and Baclic).
verification.reference: worked examples of the EES help pages hs10, hs20, hs30, hs40, hs50, hs60, hs70, hs80, hs90, hs100, hs110, hs120, hs130, hs135, hs140, hs150, hs160 and hs170 of https://fchartsoftware.com/ees/heat_transfer_library/heat_exchangers/ (epsilon from NTU and NTU from epsilon); the relations are those of CSL-0090 and CSL-0102, verified against ht 1.2.0
verification.notes: README.md, Verification: table of the 33 values. The relative deviations are those of the EES values printed with 3 or 4 significant digits; the round trip epsilon -> NTU -> epsilon of the numerically inverted types agrees to 1e-11 (8e-12 for crossflow_both_unmixed, 0 for 12TEMAG). Needs CoolSolve with $INCLUDE (CS-FEAT-IMPORT).

history.action: added (replaces the CoolSolve gap CS-GAP-HX by a library function model)
